title: Tests cannot fail: the suite mocks the subject under test and asserts tautologies
description: The first test replaces finalPrice with jest.fn().mockReturnValue(110) and asserts the mock returned 110 — finalPrice itself is never executed. The second test (line 12) asserts only expect(finalPrice).toBeDefined(), which the import already guarantees. Neither test can catch a behavioral regression; one consolidated finding per the style command reporting policy.
